memorial_details:
Name: Wellington Bomber T2520
Type: Cairn
Description: Cairn comprising various sized boulders, leading up to a peak. At top centre a large wooden Latin cross.. At the base a smaller wooden cross with metal plaque, date inscribed thereon.
Inscription: 10th December 1940 (inscribed on upper cross.)
Location: Cefn Yr Ystrad Off Trefil Rd 3 Km From Trefil Blaenau Gwent Gwent NP22 4EW Wales
Grid Ref: SO120 128
Coordinates: 51.806892448710,-3.277746232593
Photos: https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/106/616/large_65500a.jpg; https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/106/617/large_65500b.jpg; https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/106/618/large_65500c_1.jpg

10th December 1940 (inscribed on upper cross.)

A cairn bearing crosses and a commemorative plaque now stands at the site to mark where they fell.
narrative: Pilot Officer Tindall and his crew were on a bombing operation when Wellington T2520 came down in the Peak/Pennines on the night of 9–10 December 1940. The precise cause of the crash is not recorded in available sources. All on board were killed: Sergeant Brown, Sergeant Hilton Daniel Ellis, Sergeant Howard, Sergeant Mills, and Pilot Officer Tindall. Records indicate six lives were lost in total, though five crew members are identified by name.
